temporal_state_chain.observed: Shirley appears somber at the funeral, says the loss has been tough, wonders if more could have been done, and admits it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knows Shirley cared for the patient and may be sad, but she has not yet confirmed how deeply the loss is affecting her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Sara's suspicion that Shirley is deeply affected is confirmed and deepened.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply grieving the patient's death and is struggling with self-doubt and letting go.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort and reassure Shirley, remind her of the good care they provided, and offer support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Shirley explicitly says she feels responsible and wonders if pushing for a different treatment approach might have changed the outcome; she appreciates Sara's reassurance but finds it hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is deeply affected and struggling to let go, and she suspects Shirley may be carrying guilt or responsibility.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Shirley's sense of responsibility is confirmed rather than merely suspected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels personally responsible for the outcome and is burdened by guilt; she needs help carrying and reframing that burden.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Alleviate Shirley's guilt by reassuring her that their decisions were made with the information available and that she does not have to carry it alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley remains reserved and minimally expressive; when confronted, Shirley admits she holds back feelings because she fears seeming unprofessional or weak, and says she will try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving and feeling responsible, and she has observed Shirley being reserved and minimally expressive; she suspects Shirley is suppressing emotions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Shirley's emotional suppression is confirmed, and its reason is clarified as fear of appearing weak or unprofessional.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is holding back emotions due to fear of judgment, but she may be willing to open up with encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her feelings safely and reassure her that emotional openness is healthy, especially among friends.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for coming on too strong; Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and says continued talking helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and worries it may have strained the friendship, though she still believes Shirley needs support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Shirley is not estranged; she understands Sara's intent and values their talks.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The friendship remains intact or can be mended; Shirley appreciates Sara's apology and wants continued communication.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Mend the relationship, stay supportive, and continue being available to talk in whatever way Shirley needs.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved; Shirley confirms she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support, and agrees to plan a weekend together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is gradually improving and that their talks and support have been helpful, but she still wants to check in and offer further support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Shirley's improvement and positive response to support are confirmed, and she is open to spending time outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is doing better with support and values Sara's friendship; additional social support may help her continue improving.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley, plan a weekend outing, and spend more time together outside work.
